contracts.action: Change folder: after relocating, re-detect the sync provider, run a bounded availability probe, and return the workspace view in the result
contracts.equivalent_path: createWorkspace and addWorkspace in the same file: both call syncStates.refresh(outcome.entry) and then availabilityOf. editWorkspace also builds the view with toWorkspaceView(..., syncStates.of(entry)).
contracts.before_after: Before this change the relocate result had no workspace view and the sync provider was not re-detected. Now the new path is detected first (index.ts:755), then availabilityOf (index.ts:756), which bounds the probe for synced folders (index.ts:176-180). refreshTitles and broadcastState follow, the same order as create and edit.
contracts.visible_effect: The renderer receives the workspace view with the availability and sync provider of the new folder, and the broadcast carries the same state.
contracts.failure_mode: The new entry is re-read from the registry (index.ts:754), so it uses the stored path. detectSync wraps its probes in timeouts (synced-folder.ts:80-90), so a stalled provider yields null instead of hanging. I did not confirm that the default realpath dep never rejects. A rejection would propagate out of the IPC handler after the relocation was already committed.
